Supplementary Fig. S1 Enrichment of CD36+ pro-inflammatory macrophage in cancer
correlates with poor outcome of patients with PTC. A, Violin plots displaying tumor
marker genes expression in peritumor and tumor cells. B, Gene expression patterns
projected onto UMAP plots of CD68, CD8A, CD4, FOXP3, KLRB1, CD19, TNFRSF17,
MKI67, ULEC4C, TG, VWF and COL1A2. C, Bar chart illustrating the percentage ratio
of eleven cell types in tumor and peritumor tissues. D, Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
(GSEA) of tumor cells in high and low myeloid cell infiltration groups using scRNAseq data. ES, enrichment score; NES, normalized enrichment score. E, Dot plot
displaying the expression of selected genes related to the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway.
